annual_ordo.limitations: Includes local anniversaries and adoration schedules. Page 10 prints the Ash transfer year as 2025; page 36 prints Lc 9,11-28 for November 18. Neither is silently repaired or accepted as a rule. Page 36 lists both Sunday 33 and Martyrs external solemnity, with readings from the Commons, and cites CD 878/90 for November 24. This is not the underlying decree, territorial applicability or an authorized national default Gospel. The year-B tail has dates but not the complete Gospel references.

reviews.applicability: National proclamation independently assigns Corpus Christi. Use the annual Ordo as the primary Gospel citation: its explicit June 7 assignment on printed page 24 gives Ga 6,51-58 for this named year-A Mass; the evidence date denotes that assignment, not a fresh dated page. The Gospel body's ending and page tag support that endpoint in the local canonical numbering. Preserve the different printed endpoint as an edition/editorial discrepancy; do not globally equate 51-58 with 51-59 or silently label the source an error. This does not adopt Vinh Long's calendar.
reviews.text_review: Eight existing rows include living bread, the dispute, eating/drinking, resurrection, mutual indwelling and living forever. Local verse 59 is the distinct synagogue-location sentence, absent from the printed Gospel body, and is not included. No shared text is modified.
